title: 428. Design Tic-Tac-Toe

examples.explanation: Player 1 seals the bottom row on the last placement.
Player 1 completes the top row of the small board.

hints: Adaptation: replay the trace with counters rather than building a class.
Score player 1 as +1 and player 2 as -1 across per-row, per-column, and two diagonal tallies.
A tally reaching +n or -n means that player owns the whole line.
